heading: INT. FLOODED PUMP HOUSE - RICE TERRACES - DAWN

units.text: INT. FLOODED PUMP HOUSE - RICE TERRACES - DAWN
Grey light leaks through a tin roof pocked with shrapnel holes.
Knee-deep brown water slops against concrete walls.

SERGEANT HADIZA BELLO, forties, mud to the elbows, crouches on a pump housing with a radio handset wedged against her shoulder, while CORPORAL TOMEK WRONA, a lanky twenty-two-year-old with a bandaged ear, wades in from the doorway and sets a dented ammo can on the ledge beside her.
She doesn't look at him.

He opens the can, counts what's left, and shuts it again, and behind them PRIVATE LI WEI, nineteen, thin as a rake, sits against the far wall with his rifle across his knees, staring at the water as if it might hand him an answer.
Say again, Control. Say again.
units.name: BELLO

units.text: Static.
She lowers the handset and lets it hang by its cord.
Anything?
units.name: WRONA

units.text: They're calling it off.
units.name: BELLO

units.text: Off.
units.name: WRONA

units.text: The push. Guns have stopped. Whatever they were going to do up the hill, they're not doing it.
units.name: BELLO

units.text: Li Wei looks up.
He tries to speak, coughs, and tries again.
So we go home?
units.name: LI WEI

units.text: We go back to the road. That's not the same thing.
units.name: BELLO

units.text: She slides off the housing into the water and he grimaces at the cold of it, then steadies himself on the wall while Wrona reaches for the can and hauls it onto his shoulder.
They're all slow now, all of them moving like men who have been told to stop running and haven't yet believed it.
Captain's still up there.
units.name: WRONA

units.text: I know where the Captain is.
units.name: BELLO

units.text: A VOICE crackles from the handset, small and tinny.
Bello. Bello, it's Duarte. I'm coming down. Hold the pump house.
units.name: CAPTAIN DUARTE

units.text: Bello lifts the handset.
She stares at it a moment before answering, and Wrona watches her face for the thing she won't say.
Holding, sir.
units.name: BELLO

units.text: She hangs it back on its hook.
Li Wei lets out a breath that turns into a laugh and then into something quieter.
Nobody tells him to stop.
I thought we were done.
units.name: LI WEI

units.text: We are done. Get some water in you.
units.name: BELLO

units.text: She wades to the door and leans on the frame, looking out at the terraces going silver in the light.
Wrona joins her, and for a while neither of them says anything at all.
It's quiet.
units.name: WRONA

units.text: Don't say that out loud.
units.name: BELLO
